content.short: MEW wallet is a free, open-source, non-custodial wallet to buy, manage, and swap crypto.
content.description: MEW Wallet is a non-custodial wallet that supports Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, Fantom, Arbitrum, StarkNet, and Multichain. You can create a wallet, buy and sell crypto, and swap, hold, send, and receive tokens across these networks. It also enables exchanging crypto, staking to earn rewards, and convenient access to DeFi and Web3 sites, letting you navigate decentralized finance from a single app. With multi-chain support, you can move assets between networks, manage tokens across ecosystems, and interact with DeFi apps directly from MEW Wallet.
content.meta: MEW wallet lets you buy, swap, and manage crypto in a non-custodial app. Discover MEW wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
